description:
About the job

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.




Job Summary:

We’re looking for a results-driven Marketing Specialist to support and execute key marketing initiatives across email, content, SEO, and social media. This role is primarily focused on email marketing, automation, optimization, and analysis, and requires deep expertise in Marketing Automation (ideally in Salesforce Marketing Cloud). The ideal candidate will also be able to create high-quality written content for blogs, SEO, and social channels.




This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.




Responsibilities:




Email Marketing, Automation, Optimization, and Analysis

Own the execution of email marketing campaigns from planning through deployment, QA, testing, reporting, and optimization.

Develop email content aligned with campaign goals, brand voice, and audience needs.
Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and audience segments to improve performance.
Monitor and analyze campaign performance, including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, engagement, and other KPIs.
Apply best practices across deliverability, compliance, personalization, and lifecycle marketing.
Translate campaign insights into actionable recommendations to improve future performance.




Blog and SEO Writing

Write and edit high-quality blog content aligned with brand messaging, audience interests, and SEO goals, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Create SEO-focused content and optimize written content for target keywords, search intent, readability, and internal linking.
Refresh and optimize existing blog content to improve rankings and performance.
Ensure all written content is clear, accurate, engaging, and on-brand.




Social Media Content

Create compelling social media copy and content concepts that support broader campaign and content objectives.
Support the content calendar with consistent, brand-aligned content across relevant channels.
Adapt campaign, blog, and email messaging into channel-appropriate social content.
Monitor content performance and recommend improvements based on engagement data and audience response.




Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required.
5+ years of experience in marketing with strong emphasis on email marketing and automation.
If not familiar with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, willingness to quickly adapt to it.
Strong experience writing marketing content across email, blog, SEO, and social media formats.
Strong understanding of SEO and on-page optimization best practices.
Experience with audience segmentation, email testing, and campaign optimization.
Ability to interpret performance data and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and project management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally and independently.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.




Nice to Have:

Experience in B2B marketing
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including hands-on experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, and Contact Builder
Familiarity with HTML/CSS for email formatting and minor template edits
Familiarity with SQL or AMPscript within Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Experience using analytics and reporting tools to measure content and campaign performance

description:
About the job

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About Akai

Akai by Deel is the agent platform built for your operations. We build cutting-edge AI technology to automate the manual, repetitive work that operational teams grind through every day — the work that doesn’t have an API, doesn’t have a clean integration, and doesn’t get solved by traditional automation.

We built Akai out of Deel’s own frustration. To run one of the most complex financial structures in the world — transacting billions of dollars per month across 170+ countries — we needed agents that could operate the same systems our teams do, only faster, more accurately, and without the burnout. Nothing on the market did it. So we built it ourselves and it worked. Now we’re bringing it to every operations team that’s been told to “just hire more people” to clear the queue.We're operating as a small, scrappy team inside Deel — engineering-led, moving fast, defining what delivery looks like as we go.

The role

We're looking for a Founding Forward Deployed Engineer to help us build the delivery function from the ground up. You'll work directly with Fortune 500 finance and operations teams — sitting with them, understanding what they're actually stuck on, and building the agents and custom tooling that solve it. You own the outcome end-to-end and will be expected to be ready to solve your own problems and be the expert on the product.

This is a founding role in the truest sense: you are joining a small team, as one of the first client-facing roles and you will define how Akai delivers value to customers as we scale. That means the role is unusually generative — you'll shape the playbook, not follow one.

We're being deliberate about the profile: we're not looking for a senior specialist. We're looking for someone 2-4 years into their career who's been building things — with AI, with agents, with automation — on the side, and wants to make that the day job. Hungry, adaptable, and comfortable being dropped into ambiguous customer environments where the right answer isn't obvious yet.

What you'll do


Own customer implementations end-to-end. Discovery, solution design, agent build, deployment, monitoring, expansion — you're the technical relationship
Sit with enterprise customers (finance, treasury, payments, ops teams) to understand their workflows, then translate that into agent-based solutions on the Akai platform
Write production code (AI is your best friend here). Build custom integrations against internal ERPs, portals, and proprietary systems. Ship the tooling that makes each customer successful
Feed customer learnings back into the Akai core product — you're the shortest loop between what customers need and what gets built
Drive expansion through delivery quality. Our pricing is usage-based, so effective agents = revenue growth. Your best upsell is a working demo, not a slide deck
Define what "great" looks like for the Akai FDE function as it scales from one to many


What you'll bring


2-4 years of software engineering, solutions engineering, consulting, start-up or forward-deployed experience. Titles vary, and direct engineering experience isn’t required — what matters is that you’re comfortable with understanding code, you’ve built products for customers or you’ve helped customers navigate difficult technical problems 
Comfort with ambiguity. You've worked in environments where the right answer wasn't handed to you, and you've built your way to it
Curiosity about AI agents. You don't need to be a specialist — you need to have played with LLMs, agent frameworks, or automation on your own time, and formed opinions about what works
Customer instincts. You can sit across from a Fortune 500 finance lead, understand their real problem (not the one they described first), and translate it into something buildable
Strong communication. You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder without dumbing it down
Ideally located in the Americas time zone (US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina) but we’re flexible. You will be expected to support clients predominantly in AMS and EMEA, so your timezone should reflect that


Bonus points


You've built and shipped an agent or automation project on the side, on your own initiative
Background in fintech, payments, treasury, or financial operations
Prior experience at a smaller startup where you owned outcomes across engineering, product, and customer work
You've been on an FDE-like team at a smaller AI or data infrastructure company
You've worked with legacy or undocumented systems and enjoy the reverse-engineering part


Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

description:
About the job

PoderJudicialVirtual.com | 100% remoto 




Resumen del rol

Buscamos al ingeniero que se sumará al equipo que va a construir el próximo producto de PoderJudicialVirtual de punta a punta y llevarlo a producción. Es un rol de constructor dentro de un equipo de desarrollo: entre todos toman la especificación, diseñan el backend en Laravel, construyen el frontend en Vue, integran los pagos con Stripe y lo lanzan a miles de usuarios reales. Con ownership real de tu parte del producto, sin capas intermedias y sin nadie revisándote el hombro.

No es un asiento más en una fábrica de software. Estamos ejecutando nuestro plan 2030: pasar de 2 productos en producción a 11 y expandirnos a Sudamérica. Tú construyes el primero de esa nueva ola, y quien construye bien aquí se convierte en pieza central de todo lo que sigue. El crecimiento se gana construyendo, no por antigüedad.

Te integrarás a un equipo de desarrollo en México, de la mano de un líder técnico fuerte, dueño de la arquitectura y la infraestructura, y de un Product Manager Senior que te entrega specs claras con Definition of Ready y Definition of Done. Tú eres dueño del código: de que escale, de que cobre bien y de que llegue a producción sin sorpresas.

Vas a trabajar sobre un dominio complejo (la infraestructura judicial mexicana) que tarda meses en dominarse. No esperamos que llegues sabiéndolo. Sí esperamos que en pocos meses tomes decisiones técnicas independientes y que tu código hable por ti.




Sobre nosotros

PoderJudicialVirtual es una empresa legaltech mexicana con más de 10 años en el mercado. Operamos la plataforma de datos judiciales más grande de México: más de 65 millones de registros de todo el país, con despachos, empresas y miles de personas usando y pagando el servicio todos los días. Somos rentables y no dependemos de inversionistas para ejecutar nuestro plan.




El proyecto

Arranque en septiembre de 2026. El equipo construirá un producto nuevo completo: backend en Laravel, frontend en Vue, flujo de referidos e integración de pagos con Stripe, desde la spec hasta producción. Al lanzarlo, sigue el próximo producto del plan. Aquí no se mantiene lo de otros: se construye lo propio.




Lo que buscamos




Requisitos:

• 5 años o más de experiencia profesional con PHP, idealmente Laravel.

• Capacidad real de leer, entender y mantener código existente con años de historia, no solo arrancar proyectos desde cero.

• MySQL a escala: has trabajado con tablas de millones de registros y sabes de índices y paginación eficiente.

• Vue.js sólido para trabajo full-stack.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs REST que escalan.

• Ownership: tomas un producto y lo llevas a producción. Detectas tus errores antes de entregar.

• Git con flujo profesional: manejo de branches, pull requests y participación activa en code reviews.

• Entorno de desarrollo Linux: configuración autónoma de stack local en Ubuntu (Apache, PHP, MySQL) sin dependencia de soporte externo.




Deseable (suma puntos, no descarta):

• MongoDB, 2 años o más.

• Automatización web: experiencia con Playwright, Puppeteer y gestión de proxies.

• Cloud: familiaridad con servicios de AWS.

• Inglés de lectura técnica: entender documentación, errores y recursos de desarrollo en inglés. No se requiere hablarlo.

• Experiencia integrando pasarelas de pago; Stripe en particular.




Sobre el uso de IA

Usamos IA todos los días y esperamos que tú también. La regla es simple: la IA amplifica tu criterio, no lo sustituye. Debes entender cada línea que mandas a producción. Durante el proceso vas a defender tu código en vivo, sin asistentes: explicar tus decisiones, encontrar errores en código ajeno y modificar comportamiento en tiempo real.




Soft skills (competencias clave que valoramos):

• Criterio técnico en revisión de código. Capacidad para identificar vulnerabilidades, cuellos de botella y errores de lógica, tanto en código propio como en el generado por IA.

• Ownership del resultado. Asumir plena responsabilidad sobre el código entregado. La IA es una herramienta; las decisiones y sus consecuencias son del desarrollador.

• Autonomía operativa. Capacidad para tomar un proyecto, definir el camino y ejecutarlo de principio a fin. Esperamos consultas estratégicas, no acompañamiento constante.

• Documentación de decisiones. Más allá del código, registrar el razonamiento detrás de las decisiones de arquitectura: el "por qué" que da contexto a futuras iteraciones del equipo.




Lo que ofrecemos

100% remoto.
Honorarios entre $65,000 y $80,000 brutos, acordes a tu experiencia.
Bono por objetivos ligado a que tu producto llegue a producción y cobre.
Impacto directo: lo que construyes lo usan miles de abogados y empresas desde el día uno.
Un plan 2030 real, con productos definidos y financiamiento propio, del que tu trabajo es pieza central.




Cómo aplicar

Envía tu CV junto con lo siguiente (las aplicaciones que no incluyan estos puntos no avanzan en el proceso):

Describe un sistema que hayas construido o mantenido tú y que esté (o haya estado) en producción: stack, escala de datos y usuarios, y cuál fue tu responsabilidad concreta.

About the job

About The Team

Zillow started in 2006 and is the most visited real estate website in the United States with over 10.5 billion visits in 2022, and an average of 220 million monthly unique users. Zillow helps high-intent movers find and win their home through digital solutions and first class partners. Our Zillow Mexico team will work with our US tech teams to simplify and automate the buying, selling and renting experience to make home a reality for more and more people.


 We believe that creativity, collaboration, and innovation lead to success. 
 We actively encourage our teams to learn about the business and share


their ideas.


 We value and promote a diverse and inclusive workplace!


About The Role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you’ll lead the delivery and ongoing support of projects from end-to-end. In addition, you will:


Contribute to the design of new features. 
Review the code of your peers. 
Advocate for standard methodologies. 
Facilitate engineering discussions. 
Mentor junior engineers. 
Participate in an inclusive, energetic and highly multi-functional team. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

Wondering if we're the right team for you? You'll excel in this team if you thrive on autonomy, seek out persistent problems, implement effective solutions quickly, and you are:


Bringing 5+ years of software development experience with ES6, React, Typescript, and GraphQL to power our web and mobile web applications and Python, Java, NodeJS, and Go for APIs and services. 
Experienced in a range of persistence strategies including relational and non-relational databases. 
Fluent in English and Spanish (both written and spoken).

Here at Zillow we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

Unblock teams by answering questions clearly, debugging issues fast, and proposing solutions to ambiguous problems.
At least 3 years of experience as a Backend/Software Engineer. You've shipped real AI products, features, debugged production issues, and thought about scale.
Experience developing with NodeJS or Python. You write clean, maintainable code comfortably. You understand patterns, conventions, and best practices. Syntax is muscle memory.

You know SQL and NoSQL fundamentals. Particularly strong with PostgreSQL and ORM libraries (such as Sequelize, TypeORM, or similar). You can write queries, optimize performance, and design schemas with purpose.

Demonstrated experience shipping real products using Claude. You've used AI to accelerate development and shipped features that work in production. You can prompt effectively, review AI-generated code critically, and know when to use AI versus write code manually.

Excellent communication skills—written and verbal. You explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders clearly. You write clear documentation, code comments, and Slack updates. Vous suivez les meilleures pratiques en matière de codage sécurisé, de gestion des données et de conformité.

Assure les économies de coûts et les efficacités dans le domaine de la responsabilité. Vous réfléchissez à l'utilisation des ressources, aux coûts d'infrastructure et à la vélocité de l'équipe. Vous ne gaspillez pas d'efforts ou de ressources.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

How do you build a world-class sales organization?

By assembling a team of rugged, adaptable, and highly consultative sales professionals. We are actively looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive (MX) to join our growing team in Mexico City. In this role, you will drive net-new business revenue by targeting mid-sized commercial fleets—companies that require a sophisticated value proposition paired with strong, trust-based relationship building.

The ideal Mid-Market AE is a corporate chameleon: someone with advanced business acumen who can seamlessly present ROI and financial impact to CFOs in a boardroom, and just as easily connect with fleet owners and operations managers on the ground. You will operate with an owner mindset, self-sourcing your pipeline, conducting deep consultative discovery, and navigating multi-stakeholder sales cycles to help transform physical operations across Mexico.

What You'll Do


Drive Full-Cycle Revenue Growth: Own the entire sales lifecycle from target account identification and initial outbound prospecting to discovery, solution demonstration, negotiation, and contract execution. 
Build & Manage Pipeline: Actively self-source new opportunities through targeted outbound outreach (phone, email, social) while effectively qualifying inbound interest to maintain a healthy 3x–4x pipeline coverage. 
Execute Consultative & Value-Based Selling: Conduct thorough business discovery to uncover operational inefficiencies, safety risks, and cost drivers. Quantify Motive's ROI using structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC / BANT). 
Navigate Multi-Stakeholder Deals: Engage and build consensus across diverse decision-makers within mid-sized businesses, including C-suite executives, directors of operations, safety managers, and fleet directors. 
Maintain CRM & Forecast Accuracy: Keep meticulous records of all sales activities, account intelligence, and opportunity stages in Salesforce to deliver accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts. 
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Pre-Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Implementation teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and long-term retention. 


What We're Looking For


Relevant Sales Experience: 3–5+ years of full-cycle B2B closing experience, ideally selling complex software, SaaS, IoT, hardware, or technology solutions to Mid-Market businesses. 
The "Corporate Chameleon" Persona: Exceptional interpersonal adaptability with the ability to build rapport with operational field leaders while commanding authority in executive meetings. 
Proven Outbound Prospecting Discipline: A track record of generating a significant portion of your own pipeline without relying solely on SDRs or marketing inbound leads. 
Bilingual Proficiency: Professional fluency in both Spanish and English (written and verbal). 
Track Record of Overachievement: Demonstrated history of consistently meeting or exceeding quota targets ($50K+ average deal size / ACV experience preferred). 
Adaptability & Grit: High resilience, street-smart problem-solving skills, and the drive to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. 
Education: Bachelor’s degree required. 


Work Environment

This is a hybrid role based out of our Mexico City office (2–3 days per week in-office). Candidates must reside in or be willing to commute to the Mexico City area.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. 

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology. 

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The Team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Global Finance team is the operational backbone of one of the world's most trusted and longest-standing crypto exchanges. The team spans accounting, FP&A, treasury, tax, and finance operations across multiple regulated entities and 70+ countries, managing the financial infrastructure that underpins everything from daily close to regulatory reporting to crypto-native asset reconciliation.

As financial complexity grows with Kraken's global footprint, this role architectures and provides hands-on building to scale growth. Finance operations at a globally regulated crypto exchange managing close cycles, reconciliations, reporting, treasury monitoring, and controls validation all generate substantial manual effort tied to critical financial and regulatory obligations. Errors carry audit, SOX, security ,and regulatory consequences.

The Opportunity

You will serve as the primary architect and builder of the AI-native finance operating system at Kraken. This role spans two simultaneous horizons: deploying production automation now and redesigning the finance architecture for the long term. Responsibilities span five core areas:

Assess and map Finance operations


Evaluate how financial work currently flows across the organization, including close, reconciliations, treasury, reporting, controls validation, and audit preparation.
Identify capability gaps, manual bottlenecks, and integration failure points across systems including NetSuite, BlackLine, Kyriba, Fireblocks, and Lukka.
Benchmark current operations against best-in-class practices and emerging AI capabilities to build the Finance automation roadmap, prioritized by operational leverage and regulatory risk.
Work directly with accounting, FP&A, treasury, and finance operations teams to translate process pain points into buildable automation requirements.


Architect the agentic finance platform


Design the long-term architecture for an AI-native finance operating system. Define how agentic systems interact with financial infrastructure, data pipelines, and control and reporting frameworks.
Evaluate Kraken's existing finance systems stack from first principles, including platforms and the interfaces and data flows between them. Identify opportunities to simplify the stack, reduce manual intervention, and define a scalable target architecture.
Build an agentic finance layer that runs alongside the existing stack today, automating workflows while defining the migration path toward a more scalable, AI-native architecture over time.


Build and deploy production finance automation


Deploy production-grade agentic workflows that automate finance operations: reconciliations, close processes, audit and reporting preparation, treasury monitoring, financial analytics, and controls validation.
Build using modern AI tooling including Claude and Anthropic APIs, Python-based orchestration, n8n or equivalent workflow engines, and MCP or similar agent coordination layers.
Integrate internal and external systems by connecting APIs, data sources, and tools into unified automated workflows that deliver real operational leverage.
Maintain human oversight where appropriate. Design for auditability and control integrity, not just efficiency.


Own AI governance for Finance


Establish guardrails that allow automation and agent behavior to operate safely in a SOX-regulated financial environment. Define which controls are maintained, which are redesigned, and how workflow scope preserves control integrity.
Build frameworks covering data classification, auditability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, failure detection, rollback mechanisms, regulatory compliance, and audit-ready design documentation.
Classify all automation builds by risk tier before work begins. No build goes to production without a named Process Owner, documented data flows, access controls, and audit logging confirmed.
Serve as the Finance domain representative in Kraken's Automate Everything Center of Excellence, contributing to governance standards and cross-functional build alignment.


Build the foundation for AI-native Finance


Create reusable frameworks, workflow templates, and documentation so that future Finance team members can safely build on top of the platform without relying on a single specialist.
Train finance professionals on AI-assisted tools and workflows deployed in production. Drive adoption and operational independence, not just delivery.
Build metrics, dashboards, and performance frameworks to measure efficiency gains, cost reduction, risk outcomes, and ROI from automation and AI initiatives.
Provide leadership reporting on operational improvements, risk posture, and the finance platform roadmap.


What You Bring

This role is designed for a technical builder and systems architect who has already deployed agentic systems in production.


Proven track record designing, deploying, and scaling agentic AI systems in production environments used by others, not just experimentation or internal demos.
Deep understanding of LLM orchestration, multi-agent system design, and the failure modes of autonomous AI workflows in high-stakes operational environments.
Strong systems architecture capability: able to move from discovery to design to build to deployment to optimization without relying on external consultants.
Hands-on proficiency with modern AI automation tooling: Claude/Anthropic APIs, Python-based orchestration, n8n or equivalent workflow engines, MCP or similar agent coordination layers.
Strong domain knowledge of finance operations including close processes, reconciliations, treasury, financial reporting, and controls in a regulated environment.
Experience deploying automation in a SOX-regulated or equivalent compliance environment, with demonstrated understanding of which controls must be preserved and how to design automation that maintains audit integrity.
Ability to translate finance and business requirements into technical roadmaps and scalable operational solutions.
Strong communicator who can bridge finance, technical, and business teams while influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross-functional alignment.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with a high level of ownership and bias toward execution.


Nice to Have


Experience with Finance systems stack or equivalent enterprise platforms: NetSuite, BlackLine, Kyriba, Fireblocks, or Lukka.
Background as a Head of Product or Head of Engineering at an AI-native company, AI systems architect, or founder or early engineer at an agentic infrastructure company.
Familiarity with crypto-native financial infrastructure including digital asset custody, on-chain reconciliation, and blockchain-based accounting workflows.
Experience in high-velocity or resource-constrained environments: startup, PE-backed company, or an understaffed finance team where you had to build the system yourself.
Familiarity with data privacy, information governance, or compliance systems in a financial services context.
Experience managing vendor relationships and procurement for finance technology platforms.

description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Founding Sales Lead




About the Company:

Our client pushes brand creative across a creator network, analyzes performance data, and identifies winning content to be used as ads before paid spend is allocated. They aim to eliminate the guesswork in ad creative selection for DTC brands.




Job Description:

This role is responsible for building and scaling the top of the sales funnel. Currently, growth relies on relationships and founder-led selling, which is not scalable. The successful candidate will own the pipeline development process, transforming a smaller base of clients into a larger one by establishing a scalable sales process. This is a foundational role where the individual will be responsible for creating the sales playbook, messaging, and channel strategy.

The market is large and the category is emerging, with a product that is proven to work and can be demonstrated with data. The role offers the opportunity to significantly impact the company's early growth and sales infrastructure.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Execute multi-channel outbound sales activities (email, LinkedIn, phone) targeting DTC and ecommerce brands.

• Minimize inbound lead response time to ensure the company is the fastest to engage with potential buyers.

• Leverage existing networks (investors, partners, past clients) to generate warm leads and secure meetings.

• Conduct thorough research on target brands' existing creative strategies to personalize outreach.

• Ensure clean and detailed notes are passed to the next stage of the sales process for effective follow-up.

• Maintain CRM data integrity, ensuring all activities are accurately recorded.

• Provide market feedback on objections, effective messaging, and list performance to inform strategy.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 1-3 years of experience in a sales development or account executive role.

• Experience selling to marketing, ecommerce, or agency buyers is preferred.

• Demonstrated passion for sales.

• Ability to manage and maintain over 100 live accounts simultaneously.

• Capacity to receive feedback and adapt behavior quickly.

• Interest in consumer brands and short-form video content.




Preferred Skills:

• Prior experience selling agency or marketing services.

• Experience building sales lists and running outreach sequences independently.

• Existing network within the DTC, ecommerce, or performance marketing sectors.




Personality:

• Proactive and self-starting attitude.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Adaptable and eager to learn.

• Results-oriented and driven.




Software & Tools:

• CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

• Sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft)

• LinkedIn Sales Navigator




Schedule:

Full-time

Remote or In-office in Williamsburg




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

title: Copywriter (Ad and Video Script)
description:
About the job

TechLoom Global connects industry-leading companies across various sectors with top-tier global talent. Our expertise spans a wide range of functions, including sales development, product and engineering, marketing, operations, customer success, finance, and administrative support. As a TechLoom Global team member, you become part of a network of high-caliber professionals delivering real impact for forward-thinking companies navigating today's dynamic and competitive landscape.




This role joins an established copywriting team at a fast-paced, high-growth auto and dealership marketing company, adding capacity as the client scales its content output. The Copywriter is responsible for producing direct-response video ad scripts and accompanying ad copy for dealership and retail clients, working entirely from secondhand source material — onboarding call recordings, client websites, and social content — with no direct client contact. All briefs and context are routed through a Client Success Manager, making the ability to extract and interpret information independently a core function of the role.




RESPONSIBILITIES

• Write direct-response video ad scripts and accompanying ad copy from secondhand client source material.

• Extract brand and product information from onboarding call recordings, notes, websites, and social content.

• Deliver completed scripts within a 3-day turnaround window: intake received day 1, scripts delivered by day 3.

• Interpret creative briefs accurately on the first pass, hitting the core brief without requiring structural revisions.

• Work independently after a 2-3 week ramp-up period with minimal ongoing direction.

• Integrate AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT into the daily writing workflow to support efficiency without replacing craft.

• Coordinate with the Client Success Manager to receive all necessary context and submit deliverables via ClickUp and Google Drive.

• Maintain and grow creative quality over time, demonstrated through reviewed writing output and samples.




REQUIREMENTS

• 3 to 6 years of direct-response ad copywriting experience, specifically in video ad scripts and accompanying ad copy — not general content writing.

• Demonstrated ability to work from secondhand source material, including call recordings, client websites, and social content, without direct client access.

• High creative ownership and the ability to work independently after a short ramp-up of 2 to 3 weeks.

• Active use of Claude or ChatGPT as part of a daily writing workflow.

• Ability to consistently deliver scripts within a 3-day turnaround window.

• Fluent written English.




NICE TO HAVES

• Familiarity with ClickUp as a project management and task coordination tool.

• Experience writing for the automotive, powersports, RV, or similar retail and dealership space.

• A strong enough track record to eventually take on copywriting projects outside the dealership niche, a path open to writers who prove out at a high level.

skills: Provide day-to-day operational support for IP telephony (IPT), Unified Messaging, conferencing platforms, and associated telecom services, acting as the local point of contact for incidents and requests.

Troubleshoot and resolve telecom issues including circuits, call routing, PBX/IPT configurations, SIP trunks, and user-level telephony problems; triage and manage tickets through to completion or escalation.

Execute standard BAU configuration, deployment, and change activities (IMAC, capacity expansion, performance management, refresh activities), following change management and operational controls.
Deliver operational support for IP telephony, unified messaging, conferencing, and related telecom platforms to ensure high availability and a consistent end-user experience.
Own incident and request handling for telecom services: triage tickets, troubleshoot end-to-end issues (circuits, SIP/PBX/IPT, call routing, endpoints), and escalate effectively when required.
Monitor service health and performance (call quality, latency, packet loss, capacity, usage trends), performing proactive checks and driving corrective actions to reduce outages and improve MTTR.
Execute BAU engineering activities including IMAC, routine configuration changes, deployments, capacity upgrades, and hardware/technology refresh in line with change management standards.
Support project delivery by completing build/configuration tasks, testing and certification, documentation (“as-built”), and operational handover to ensure solutions are supportable in production.
2-3 years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise telecommunications environments, including IP telephony/VoIP, unified messaging, and conferencing platforms.
Working knowledge of PBX/IPT concepts and troubleshooting (e.g., call routing, dial plans, SIP trunks, circuit issues, endpoint/user telephony problems) in a production setting.

Experience with operational monitoring and performance analysis for voice/mobile services (KPIs such as call quality, latency, jitter/packet loss, capacity/usage trends) and using data to drive remediation.
Proficiency producing operational reports and dashboards using tools such as Excel and SQL, with exposure to visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or Tableau) preferred.

Strong customer-facing support skills with proven ability to prioritize and manage incidents/changes in a ticketing environment, including participation in an on-call rotation and adherence to changing management and security standards.

Se você tem as qualidades e a motivação para liderar você mesmo ou equipes, há funções prontas para cultivar suas habilidades e levá-lo(a) para o próximo nível.

Descrição Do Cargo

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. As the clinical and advanced therapy part of UPS Healthcare, we reach patients faster, with greater scalability and access to new pathways throughout the supply chain. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Permanente

title: Auxiliar, Atencion a Cliente
description:
About the job

Empresa:

eHubs es una empresa especializada en desarrollar y operar una red de inmuebles de hiper proximidad, permitiendo que las marcas se acerquen físicamente a sus clientes.

Rol:

Gestionar y desarrollar las cuentas clave de la compañía, trabajando de manera coordinada con el equipo directivo para consolidar y fortalecer las relaciones comerciales con los clientes. Será el principal punto de contacto en el día a día, responsable de dar seguimiento a las cuentas existentes y a las oportunidades en pipeline, asegurando el cierre de nuevos negocios, la renovación de contratos y el crecimiento de las cuentas mediante una atención cercana, estratégica y orientada a resultados.

Principales Funciones:

1. Gestión de oportunidades

Dar seguimiento a las oportunidades comerciales hasta su cierre, incluyendo propuestas, visitas a sitio, negociaciones y formalización de contratos.

Elaborar propuestas comerciales y cotizaciones alineadas a los objetivos.

Coordinar el proceso de cierre con clientes y áreas internas involucradas.

2. Renovación y desarrollo de cuentas

Gestionar oportunamente las renovaciones de contratos.

Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante nuevos espacios, ubicaciones o servicios.

Fortalecer la relación con los clientes para impulsar su fidelización y generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

3. Coordinación y atención al cliente

Ser el enlace principal entre el cliente y las áreas internas para asegurar una atención oportuna.

Coordinar con Operaciones, Legal, Finanzas, Mantenimiento y proveedores la correcta ejecución de los compromisos adquiridos.

4. Administración y seguimiento comercial

Mantener actualizado el CRM y dar seguimiento a las distintas etapas de cada oportunidad.

Supervisar el avance de contratos, órdenes de compra, facturación y cobranza en coordinación con las áreas correspondientes.

5. Reportes y control de resultados

Presentar el estatus de las cuentas y del pipeline comercial.

Elaborar reportes e indicadores de desempeño para la Dirección y seguimiento de KPIs.

Requisitos:

- Licenciatura concluida

- 2+ años trabajando en servicio a cliente B2B.

- (Deseable) Experiencia en Real Estate Comercial (retail, industrial o logístico) y/o en arrendamientos comerciales y negociación de contratos.

Otros:

- Manejo de CRM, Excel y elaboración de propuestas y presentaciones comerciales.

- Disponibilidad para realizar visitas y recorridos con clientes en la Ciudad de México y su área metropolitana (auto propio idealmente).

With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

About the job

Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible) | Fluent English required




Salary: $800 to $1,300 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.




The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.




You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.




We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one. You care about quality over quantity. You believe hiring one outstanding person beats hiring ten average ones, and you would rather send us three excellent candidates than thirty adequate ones.




The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:




80% Recruiting & Talent Acquisition

Your primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.




20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business Support

We're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.




Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.




We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.




What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.




Day to day, that means you:

Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.
Present hiring managers with highly qualified candidates instead of large numbers of average applicants.
Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.

What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:




Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

Lifecycle Marketing: Email Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing Managers

Sales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals




As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.

title: Trade Marketing Manager
description:
About the job

JOB DESCRIPTION

Would you like to make a positive impact on the planet? - Take flight with Birdman! 🦅


The Company

Birdman is the leading plant-based food and supplements company in Mexico, with sustained growth of over 100% YoY for 7 consecutive years. We strive to facilitate the transition to healthier, more sustainable, and cruelty-free lifestyles through delicious and nutritious products. Come and build the next Mexican Unicorn with us! 🌱🦅


The Role

This is a doer role — the most hands-on, sales-floor-connected position in the area. We're building Trade Marketing from the ground up, and we need someone who makes things happen without waiting for anyone to hand them a finished plan. You'll live at the point of sale, own execution end to end, and thrive in ambiguity where roughly 90% of the process doesn't exist yet.

You're a high-energy, hyperactive, pusher personality with strong people skills and a real commercial drive. You know how to build supplier relationships, negotiate under tight timelines, manage stress from complex value chains, and get displays live and selling. You think about ROI, cost, and velocity — but you never stop at thinking. You execute. Get ready to make a difference! 🌱🚀🦅


Key Responsibilities:

🎯 Channel planning & activation: Build the channel activation plan (displays, sampling, POP, execution windows) within the Head of Modern Trade's promo calendar and the G2N framework, and land it account by account alongside the KAMs.

📈 Sell-out velocity (co-owned with KAMs): Monitor velocity by account and SKU using RGM data, and trigger floor actions when velocity drops — without waiting to be asked.

🤝 Build the connections that don't exist: Store managers, floor leads, agencies, Marketing and brand — unlock execution the formal process doesn't solve.

🛒 Own displays end to end: Shelf and special displays, both paid and earned. Maximize the return on paid displays (negotiated by KAMs) — placement, setup, maintenance, restock, and uplift measurement — and win unpaid ("earned") space through direct store relationships.

📸 Point-of-sale execution: Translate the channel promo calendar into in-store execution plans by client and cluster; ensure correct price, assortment, planogram, and promo compliance on the floor with regular physical store presence; and define the "picture of success" standards.

🔍 Execution auditing: Design and run the audit framework (routes, checklists for OSA, price compliance, planogram, POP), publish findings and actions by account, follow up with KAMs to closure, and run competitive field audits (price, display, promo activity) as input for RGM.

👥 Agency management: Govern merchandising and sampling agencies end to end — scope, coverage, productivity, quality, and cost — and certify field force and merchandisers on portfolio, planogram, and product attributes at every launch.

🎉 Activation, sampling & materials: Run the in-store and club (Costco, Sam's) sampling calendar, design/produce/distribute POP/POS materials with cost and timing control, and develop sell-in support materials for KAMs.

title: Líder de Exhibición Visual
description:
About the job

Quienes somos:

Grupo empresarial de capital mexicano fundado en Culiacán, Sinaloa. En 2021 cumple 80 años mejorando la vida de millones de mexicanos. Tiene presencia en todos los estados del país, cuenta con 113,000 colaboradores y es uno de los 10 principales empleadores de la República Mexicana. Se integra por tres unidades de negocio: Tiendas Coppel, Afore Coppel y BanCoppel.




"En Grupo Coppel somos una comunidad en donde la dignidad humana prevalece sobre cualquier otra condición, por ese motivo apoyamos la inclusión, la diversidad y la igualdad de oportunidades sin hacer diferencia por raza, lugar de origen, religión, creencias, edad, imagen, orientación sexual, identidad de género, discapacidad, etc."




Objetivo del puesto

Asegurar la estandarización y excelencia visual en el punto de venta mediante la ejecución técnica de guías de exhibición, el mantenimiento preventivo de la imagen y la transferencia de habilidades operativas al personal de tienda, para garantizar una experiencia de compra homologada y maximizar la rentabilidad de los espacios comerciales.




Responsabilidades:

• Implementar la exhibición mediante la ejecución e instalación física de lo definido en manuales y guías normativas en conjunto con los colaboradores de tienda, integrando el análisis de ventas para potenciar los resultados y asegurar que cualquier ajuste en el piso de venta priorice la estrategia comercial, la rentabilidad de las categorías y el mantenimiento de la exhibición.

• Asegurar la densidad óptima del mobiliario en piso de venta mediante el monitoreo constante de espacios y la coordinación del resurtido interno inmediato desde bodega en tiendas C+, garantizando que la exhibición se mantenga completa, ordenada y sin saturación para maximizar la disponibilidad al cliente y la imagen de marca.

• Ejecutar en las tiendas C+ y supervisar el cumplimiento del montaje de campañas, aparadores, exhibidores y nuevos proyectos, asegurando la actualización de la exhibición cada 15 días para mantener una imagen renovada ante el cliente y garantizar el cumplimiento de guías, manuales y campaña vigente.

• Capacitar al Gerente de Tienda y Asesores de Venta habilitando competencias y técnicas operativas de exhibición (doblado, perfilado, styling y cross-merchandising), realizando acompañamiento práctico en el piso de venta e implementando programas de entrenamiento práctico en sitio alineados a las Guías de Capacitación oficiales, para estandarizar la calidad del acomodo diario y asegurar la autonomía del equipo operativo.

• Verificar las condiciones visuales y funcionales de la tienda en colaboración con el Gerente de Tienda mediante recorridos de apertura y cierre, utilizando checklists de exhibición para gestionar la reparación de mobiliario, iluminación y gráficos con las áreas de Mantenimiento y Montaje, preservando así la integridad de la imagen y la seguridad del cliente.

• Gestionar el inventario físico de activos de exhibición (mobiliario y materiales) y el cumplimiento de tareas en plataforma SIGO, validando la coincidencia con el sistema SIE y atendiendo las alertas de satisfacción del cliente (Medallia), para asegurar la trazabilidad de los recursos y la mejora continua del servicio.

• Analizar los indicadores de percepción del cliente reportados en la plataforma ISA-Medallia referentes al acomodo y orden, identificando patrones de fricción y ejecutando correcciones inmediatas en la exhibición y retroalimentando al Gerente de Tienda para incrementar los niveles de satisfacción y facilitar la navegabilidad en el piso de venta.

• Supervisar y ejecutar en las tiendas C+ la aplicación de los lineamientos conceptuales de marca con apoyo de los colaboradores de tienda, interpretando los criterios técnicos de las guías en acomodos de producto y proyectos de exhibición para asegurar una identidad visual homologada que impulse el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales.




Requisitos:

• 2 años en el sector Retail desempeñando funciones de Visual Merchandising o Escaparatismo.

• Experiencia ejecutando guías visuales complejas en tiendas de gran formato o cadenas de Fast Fashion, asegurando la estandarización de marca en múltiples zonas.




Educación:

Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Diseño de Modas, Marketing, Comunicación Visual, Diseño Gráfico, Arquitectura, Diseño de Interiores o afín.

About the job

Buscamos un/a Growth Marketing Specialist que nos ayude a construir un sistema predecible de generación de demanda para nuestra agencia de desarrollo de software.

Objetivo principal

Tu objetivo será generar leads inbound calificados que lleguen directamente a nosotros y se conviertan en booked calls con prospectos potenciales.

No buscamos solamente aumentar tráfico, seguidores o impresiones. Queremos generar oportunidades reales de negocio.

Qualified Leads

Booked Calls
Conversion Rate

Pipeline generado
Clientes adquiridos / revenue atribuido a marketing
Responsabilidades

Tendrás libertad para proponer, probar, medir y optimizar diferentes canales y estrategias para conseguir resultados.

Entre tus responsabilidades podrán estar:

Diseñar y ejecutar estrategias de generación de demanda inbound.

Medir resultados y presentar aprendizajes y próximos pasos.
Lo que buscamos

Buscamos a alguien analítico, autónomo y orientado a resultados, no simplemente a alguien que ejecute campañas.

Queremos que puedas analizar nuestro negocio y decir:

“Creo que deberíamos probar este canal, con esta oferta, esta landing page y este presupuesto. Vamos a medirlo durante X tiempo y decidir con datos si escalamos, modificamos o descartamos el experimento.”

Nuestro objetivo NO es hacer outbound ni perseguir prospectos.

Queremos construir canales de adquisición donde potenciales clientes con una necesidad real de desarrollo de software nos encuentren, lleguen a Datamatic, califiquen como una buena oportunidad y agenden una llamada con nosotros.

About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Growth Engineering team builds the experiences that connect people to our ecosystem for the first time — and keeps them coming back. We design and ship the systems behind our marketing funnels, signup and KYC flows, and the key engagement features that help new users fund their accounts and explore our products. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally.

How We Work


We give engineers ownership and trust them to ship high-impact work with craftsmanship and accountability.
We move quickly, experiment often, and learn fast from data and feedback.
We work asynchronously across time zones, supporting each other with open communication and shared goals.


Why This Role Matters

Every feature you build will have a visible impact on how people discover, trust, and engage with our products globally. The Growth Engineering team operates at the intersection of product, marketing, and infrastructure — turning ideas into measurable results. If you’re an engineer who enjoys solving business problems through code and believes engineering excellence drives growth, this role is built for you.

The opportunity

As a Senior Product Engineer within the Growth team, you’ll take on complex, high-impact problems that blend product thinking and engineering excellence. You’ll work across web and mobile platforms, collaborating with design, data, and product teams to deliver features that drive measurable business outcomes. This is an ideal role for engineers who use their technical skills to create real-world impact — translating high-level business goals into engineering solutions that improve activation, retention, and monetization worldwide.


Partner with product managers, designers, and analysts to identify growth opportunities and turn them into high-quality, data-driven engineering solutions.
Implement reusable services and components that power marketing campaigns, onboarding, KYC, and first-funding experiences across web and mobile.
Collaborate on distributed systems that handle large volumes of global traffic while maintaining high performance and reliability.
Participate in design and architecture discussions, balancing user impact, scalability, and maintainability.
Measure, experiment, and iterate — using data and experimentation frameworks to understand what drives user behavior.
Uphold and improve engineering standards, performance, and security practices across the stack.


Skills You Should HODL


5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and maintaining production systems at scale.
Proficiency in building full-stack applications using one of the following: TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, or Ruby, and React or React Native.
Understanding of distributed systems, performance optimization, debugging, and secure software design.
Familiarity with infrastructure and tooling such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, or GitLab CI/CD.
A product mindset — you care about how your work moves key metrics, not just about the code itself.
Ability to operate autonomously in a globally distributed, remote-first environment.


Nice to haves


Experience with A/B testing, analytics instrumentation, or experimentation platforms.
Background in growth engineering, user funnels, lifecycle, or conversion optimization.
Familiarity with data analysis tools or experimentation frameworks.

About the job

Cargo-Partner is an international freight forwarder and logistics company specializing in Air and Ocean Freight solutions and integrated supply chain services.

We are looking for an Inside Sales professional to join our team in Puebla. This position is ideal for someone who is passionate about sales, customer service, international logistics and who wants to develop their career within the freight forwarding industry.

Previous experience in logistics, freight forwarding, transportation or a related industry is highly desirable. We are also open to candidates who have a strong interest in the logistics industry and demonstrate the commercial skills and motivation to learn.

The Role

As an Inside Sales professional you will be responsible for maintaining and developing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, preparing quotations and supporting the Outside Sales team in generating new business.

You will work closely with customers, Pricing, Operations and international agents to provide competitive and accurate Air and Ocean Freight solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Service & Account Management


Maintain regular communication with active clients and prospects through email and WhatsApp.

Email outreach

Requirements

Strong interest in developing a career within the logistics and freight forwarding industry.
Customer-oriented and commercially minded.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Comfortable making cold calls and conducting active prospecting.
Ability to follow up consistently and manage multiple opportunities.
Organized, proactive and results-oriented.


If you are a proactive, customer-focused and commercially driven professional who is interested in the world of international logistics, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Join Cargo-Partner Mexico and become part of a global team where you can develop your commercial skills, build relationships with customers around the world and grow your career in the Air & Ocean Freight industry.

About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

How do you build a world-class sales organization?

By creating a best-in-class Sales Development team. We are actively looking for driven, high-potential professionals to join our Mexico Sales Development organization to help us transform one of the most important industries on the planet.

Whether your strength lies in rapid inbound lead conversion, strategic outbound prospecting, or a mix of both, we are building a versatile team to fuel Motive's rapid expansion. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be the front-line voice of Motive—navigating organizations, identifying client challenges, and setting qualified discovery meetings for our Account Executive team.

During the interview process, we evaluate each candidate's unique strengths, communication style, and sales instincts to place you in the SDR path (Inbound, Outbound, or Hybrid) where you will thrive and make the biggest impact.

What You'll Do

Depending on your specific role focus within the team, your day-to-day will involve a combination of the following:


Drive Qualified Pipeline: Engage prospective clients to identify operational challenges, qualify business fit against our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), and book high-value meetings for Account Executives. 
Inbound Lead Execution: Act as the first point of contact for warm prospects, converting incoming inquiries, trial requests, and content downloads into qualified pipeline through rapid speed-to-lead. 
Outbound Prospecting: Execute targeted, multi-channel outreach campaigns (phone, email, social) to engage net-new accounts and decision-makers in key markets. 
Serve as the Voice of Motive: Deliver an exceptional initial customer experience, educating prospects on how Motive connects physical operations, enhances fleet safety, and automates freight. 
Opportunity Management: Diligently track interactions in Salesforce, manage follow-up cadences, and re-engage stalled or missed opportunities to maximize conversion. 


What We're Looking For

We are seeking adaptable, ambitious candidates who bring a strong foundation for sales success:


Bilingual Proficiency: Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal). 
Core Sales Instincts: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a natural ability to connect, listen actively, and articulate value quickly. 
Drive & Resilience: High energy, strong work ethic, and the grit to handle rejection while staying focused on target goals. 
Agility & Curiosity: Quick learner who thrives in a fast-paced environment—whether responding rapidly to inbound interest or strategically researching outbound accounts. 
Coachability: Low ego, open to constructive feedback, and passionate about continuous personal and career development. 
Preferred Experience: Previous SDR, cold calling, customer-facing, or Salesforce experience is a plus (though strong potential and attitude come first). 
Education: Bachelor’s Degree required. 


Work Environment

This is a hybrid role based out of our Mexico City office (2–3 days in-office per week). Candidates must reside in or be willing to commute to the Mexico City area.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.
